scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.demo: concurrently -n DEMO,WEB -c magenta,green "npm run demo -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -n API-TEST,WEB-TEST -c blue,green "npm run test:watch -w server" "npm run test:watch -w client"
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w server && npm run test:coverage -w client
